title: Integer multiplicity triples have locally finite Hⁿ-measure: Hⁿ(M ∩ K) < ∞ for compact K ⊆ U
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U, M, K ⊆ ℝ^P, θ : ℝ^P → ℝ and ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) (NVector (Eucl P) n). Assume IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ (frozen contract): M is Hⁿ-null-measurable, θ > 0 on M, θ is Hⁿ-integrable on M ∩ K' for every compact K' ⊆ U, plus the measurability and orientation fields. Assume also that θ is integer-valued on M (for every x ∈ M there is k ∈ ℕ with θ(x) = k), that K is compact and that K ⊆ U. Then Hⁿ(M ∩ K) < ∞, where Hⁿ = μHE[n] is the Hausdorff measure on ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n) (K : Set (Eucl P)), IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → (∀ x ∈ M, ∃ k : ℕ, θ x = k) → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) (M ∩ K) < ∞
